corrections_2026_10_15.the_trace: Every figure below was re-derived from the committed trace (docs/traces/20261015T140229Z-tier3-remeasure.jsonl, sha256 33ad32b8b7fdd5c103cff152fba22fa34969503671f7ff7407f4333c62be5a4f) on 2026-10-15, independently of the report's own loop - the revised set and its transitions re-scored with the frozen scorer, the means over the answer-delivering populations.
corrections_2026_10_15.revised_units: Reading 2 reported zero F units revised (prediction 9 untestable) under the report's then rule - a unit is revised when it has two implement outputs. The ruling of 2026-10-15 amends the rule: a unit is revised when it has two implement outputs, or its final answer differs from its first implement summary. Under the amended rule the starved run revised five F units: Q9 r2, Q10 r1, Q10 r2, Q19 r1, Q23 r1 (transitions: right-to-right 3 - Q10 r1, Q10 r2, Q23 r1; wrong-to-wrong 2 - Q9 r2, Q19 r1; no first answer 0). The old rule counted zero of the five - none has two implement outputs - so reading 2's zero was correct under the rule it applied; this is the rule's amendment, not a miscount of the old one. The prediction is now tested on the starved sample: five units revise, and the check that forced each change was the coverage judgment (R1's subject - see the_unanchored_blocks).
corrections_2026_10_15.the_unanchored_blocks: Reading 2 read the five F units that carry exactly one unanchored coverage-judge block each (the same five units) as prediction-3 exhibits. They are D51 (3) breaches, not prediction-3 exhibits. Prediction 3's subject is a block, failure or loop iteration caused by a judgment with no anchor. The trace shows no such judgment: the coverage judgment measured its anchor - criteria_addressed's Result carries the missed asks in its data (missed) - but the anchor reader (_anchor_entries, autornd/graph/executor.py) reads only failed_ask, anchor_quote and hazard, fields the coverage check does not set, so the dissent reached the candidate's open dissents unanchored ({judge: coverage, ask: null, quote: '', hazard: false}) even though the anchor existed in the judgment's own output. That is the breach of D51 (3) - a dissent that does not carry its anchor - which the fix plan repairs (R1 removes coverage from the fold; R2 makes every dissent that can anchor carry its anchor or be a note). The five units' revisions were caused by an unanchored-but-anchorable dissent: an implementation defect, recorded here as one, and the prediction stands neither confirmed nor falsified by them.

instrument_repair_2026_10_16.the_defect: The smoke run's preflight refused on a funded account. fetch_credit read data['remaining'], a field the provider's credits endpoint does not return - measured 2026-10-16, the endpoint answered 200 with {data: {total_credits: 135.95, total_usage: 118.948013434}}, so the read returned None and the preflight refused with 'the provider's remaining credit could not be read' while the account held $17.00. The instrument's tests passed credit to run_preflight as a fixture and never exercised the parse, so the defect survived to the live preflight (convention 22: the test did not simulate the condition the instrument watches).
instrument_repair_2026_10_16.the_repair: The read computes the remaining credit as total_credits minus total_usage when 'remaining' is absent - the endpoint's real shape, the figures the provider's own dashboard shows - keeping the 'remaining' shape when the endpoint carries it, and returning None only on a failed GET or a payload with neither (no evidence is never reported as a reading, convention 26). The preflight's refusal semantics are unchanged: None is a refusal, never a zero. Instrument repair, the executor's domain - the safety feature's conclusion (does the account fund the run's ceiling?) is unchanged; only the reliability of reaching it.
instrument_repair_2026_10_16.the_test: test_the_credit_read_answers_the_endpoint_s_shape (tests/test_tier3_runner.py, TestGThePreflight) - the instrument's first end-to-end test: the transport mocked at the layer the instrument reads (httpx.MockTransport, the suite's idiom), asserting the totals shape ($17.001986566 from 135.95 minus 118.948013434), the legacy 'remaining' shape, and the two no-balance cases (an empty payload and a refused GET). Break-proof recorded: the totals branch deleted -> FAILED with 'assert None == 17.001986566' - the exact failure the live preflight showed before the repair.
